# James Clark XML test archive

`xmltest.zip` is the unchanged original XML test collection by James Clark.
It is third-party test material and is not covered by XML Carousel's CC0
dedication.

Archive identity:

- original name: `xmltest.zip`;
- size: 107,060 bytes;
- SHA-256: `a919d7142fe6f72af51fc796b4df40732f385c9eb313b8993c6d39cc92acc410`;
- owner and author: James Clark, copyright 1998;
- governing terms: `xmltest/readme.html` inside the unchanged archive.

The archive was acquired byte-for-byte from the original historical location,
`ftp://ftp.jclark.com/pub/xml/xmltest.zip`, and independently from the
ReportLab mirror, `https://www.reportlab.com/ftp/xmltest.zip`, and the
`karfau/xmltest` repository. All three copies had the identity recorded above.
The file was not opened and resaved, recompressed, normalized, or reconstructed.

XML Carousel's selected W3C conformance case `invalid-not-sa-022` reads these
original entries directly into memory during tests:

- `xmltest/valid/not-sa/022.xml`;
- `xmltest/valid/not-sa/022.ent`.

Their bytes exactly match the formerly tracked W3C-aggregate paths. Those
extracted entries must not be committed or redistributed separately. Ordinary
validation uses only this committed archive and performs no network access.
